content_units: Best Matches for Your Watch Taste

Based on your priorities, the strongest fit is   Fleabag  , followed by   The Bear  , then   Only Murders in the Building  . These best balance sharp writing, memorable character work, some humor, and relatively manageable episode lengths without being relentlessly grim.
Ranked Picks
Rank   Show   Why it fits you   Episode length fit   Possible downside

1     Fleabag     Exceptionally smart writing, one of the best character arcs in TV, and very funny while still emotionally sharp. It never feels heavy for too long.   Excellent: mostly  25–30 min   Fast, dense style may feel a bit too self-aware if you want a more conventional drama

2     The Bear     Brilliant character writing and growth, intense but humane, with a lot of wit and energy underneath the stress. The short episodes help a lot.   Excellent: many  30 min, some longer   It can feel highly anxious and chaotic even when it is not fully bleak

3     Only Murders in the Building     Clever, light-on-its-feet mystery with strong chemistry, humor, and enough emotional depth to keep the characters engaging. Easy to watch without feeling shallow.   Strong: usually  30–40 min   The mystery-comedy tone can sometimes feel breezier than deeply transformative
Option 1:   Fleabag     Sharpest overall match for smart writing + humor + character depth   Best total fit
Option 2:   The Bear     Strongest emotional arcs with short episodes and excellent dialogue   Best if you want intensity with heart
Option 3:   Only Murders in the Building     Most enjoyable balance of wit, warmth, and low-bleakness viewing   Best comfort-watch pick
Why the Others Ranked Lower
-   Severance  : extremely smart and well-written, but it leans colder, more unsettling, and episodes often run close to or above your preferred range.
-   Dark  : brilliant and deeply layered, but probably too bleak and emotionally heavy for your stated preference.
-   Andor  : excellent writing and character work, but less humorous and often more serious than your ideal mix.
-   Derry Girls  : very funny and warm, but lighter on long-form character depth than your top matches.
-   Arcane  : great character work and craft, but emotionally heavier and more visually/intensely dramatic than your best-fit trio.
Quick Watch Path
- Start with   Fleabag   if you want the best all-around fit.
- Pick   The Bear   if you want something more intense but still rewarding.
- Pick   Only Murders in the Building   if you want the easiest, least bleak watch of the three.
